  "overall_experience": "The Head of Marketing found Klaviyo highly effective for structuring and automating complex email campaigns, appreciating its segmentation capabilities and detailed analytics. Despite some features being less relevant to their specific B2B-leaning context, the platform delivered strong functional value."
